billing.invoice_help: Invoices are emailed within 5 minutes of purchase and available under Account > Orders.
billing.duplicate_charge: If you see a duplicate charge, wait 24 hours for pending authorizations to clear, then contact support with your order number for a review.
billing.currency: All prices are charged in USD unless your storefront shows a local currency.

technical.app_reset: Try force-closing the app, clearing cache, then reinstalling if the issue persists.
technical.known_issue: Checkout spinner can hang on slow networks; wait 20s or switch Wi-Fi/cellular.
technical.browser_support: Use the latest Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox. Disable aggressive ad blockers on checkout pages.

shipping.tracking: Tracking links appear under Orders within 24 hours of dispatch.
shipping.international: International orders may take 7-14 business days and can incur customs fees paid by the customer.
shipping.address_change: Address changes are possible only before the warehouse marks the order as shipped.

account.password_reset: Use Forgot Password on the login page. Link expires in 30 minutes.
account.email_change: Email changes require verification on both old and new addresses.
account.delete_account: Account deletion requests are processed within 14 days. Open orders must be completed or cancelled first.
account.two_factor: Optional 2FA is available under Account > Security.

general.sla: We aim to reply to non-escalated tickets within one business day.
